name: SakuLove Triangle
original_name: さくらぶトライアングル
source:
Yutaro Misumi had two childhood friends who were sisters:

the cheerful and free-spirited older sister, Sakura Haruyama,

and the shy, demure younger sister, Tsubomi Haruyama.

Caught between his feelings for both Sakura and Tsubomi, Yutaro found himself unable to choose.

He assumed that, in time, the answer would simply reveal itself as they grew older.

But then, a tragic, unforeseen accident claimed Sakura’s life—

leaving Yutaro with no way to ever find that answer.

Five years later...

Sakura—who should have been dead—reappears before Yutaro and Tsubomi, looking exactly as she did five years ago.

Claiming that her greatest regret is having died a virgin, she asks Yutaro to take her virginity...

With the return of the girl who was supposed to be gone, the time that had stood still for the three of them begins to move once more.

Much like a tiny cherry blossom bud, having endured a long, cold winter, that now begins to slowly swell and bloom...

[Translated from the [url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/sakulove/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
三角优汰郎有一对身为亲姐妹的青梅竹马：

性格开朗奔放的姐姐——春山咲良，

以及腼腆文静的妹妹——春山蕾。

夹在对咲良与蕾两人的情愫之间，优汰郎迟迟无法做出抉择。

他原以为随着年龄增长，答案自会在岁月中水到渠成地揭晓。

然而一场突如其来的悲惨意外夺走了咲良的生命——

也让优汰郎永远失去了寻得那个答案的机会。

五年后……

本应离世的咲良，竟以五年前一模一样的姿态再度出现在了优汰郎与蕾的面前。

她声称自己最大的遗憾便是到死都还是处女，于是请求优汰郎收下她的第一次……

随着本应逝去的少女重返人世，三人停滞已久的时间再度开始转动。

宛如一枚熬过漫长寒冬的小小樱花花蕾，如今正悄然饱胀、含苞待放……

[译自[url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/sakulove/#story]官方网站[/url]]
